card.title: Marshmallow Mayhem
card.pitch: A sweet-toothed ambush brings squishy pixel enemies and a marshmallow launcher for a hero.
card.visualHook: A magic warning ring pops into three grinning marshmallows as a hero receives a launcher firing fluffy pixel shots.
acceptance: On deploy, show a magic telegraph immediately; after 2 seconds spawn three custom marshmallow enemies and equip one available hero with the launcher.
At 5 seconds, show a cheerful impact ring as the aftermath; the launcher remains equipped.
When the equipped hero fires, the weapon uses a custom marshmallow projectile.
!mallow repeats the sequence with a 30-second cooldown; overlapping sequences are blocked.
If no hero is present, the enemy ambush and effects still occur; equipment is conditional on an available hero.
card.feasibility: Define the enemy, projectile and hero weapon; schedule the ambush and equip a bounded hero query.
card.risk: Low: three modest enemies per activation and one equipped hero.
